build_roberta_model: build a RoBERTa encoder model with configurable layers, embed dim, and attention heads
register_classification_head: register a classification head for sentence-level classification tasks on a RoBERTa model
extract_features_roberta: extract token-level features from input tokens using the RoBERTa encoder
load_roberta_pretrained: load a pretrained RoBERTa model from a checkpoint or HuggingFace hub path
build_lm_head: build a masked language modeling head tied to the RoBERTa encoder embeddings
